companyProfiles.title: Company Profiles
companyProfiles.description: Create and manage Company Profiles, the foundation for your Company Knowledge Model.

info.title: What is a Company Profile?
info.body: A Company Profile is the starting point for building your Company Knowledge Model. It contains all relevant information about your company, your regulations, document standards, terminology and processes. The AI uses this knowledge to understand, improve and create SOPs that fit your company.

companyProfiles.noSelection: Select a company to see its profile.

companyDetail.deleteCompanyWarning:
This will permanently delete:
- Company profile and onboarding data
- All uploaded SOPs/documents
- All document chunks
- All pgvector embeddings
- All proposed/rejected/verified company CKM knowledge
- CKM evidence/provenance/history owned by this company
- Company-specific processing state
- Other company-owned generated data

This action cannot be undone.
